notes: Claude lists the assets the code needs; ChatGPT produces them; Claude integrates them.
Sizes are in pixels at 3x the logical game size (the table is 400x520 logical, rendered at up to 3x on iPhone).
status: needed -> delivered (in art/incoming/) -> integrated. Until integrated, the game draws placeholder vectors.

assets.requirements: Rounded corners transparent. Rank and suit readable at 50x70 logical: big top-left index, big suit. Hearts/diamonds crimson, spades/clubs ink.
Must not resemble any face. Symmetric under 180-degree rotation.
Reads as a coin/chip that is also a soul token. Clear silhouette at 18 logical px.
Portrait. Oval table centered in the 400x520 logical frame (table spans y 120-420 logical). Keep the board area (y 265-335 logical) low-contrast so cards stay readable.

assets.usedBy: Seat plates (P1 shows names only), dialogue and Last Claim scenes (P3)
assets.requirements: Bust portrait, consistent lighting and style across all four; readable as a 64px circle crop. Non-sexualized.
